body:
Expense-list review release. Unreleased on main since 1.16.0: T-191 (overview
count), T-192, T-193 (a voter changes nothing), T-194, T-195 (docs), plus the
review fixes T-196..T-207 (T-202 rejected as not a defect) and T-208 (AGENTS.md).
Minor version: new behaviour (voter lock-out, refusal reasons in the app, the
currency fixed server-side, a new error code invalid_list_currency, Android
schema migrations 7 and 8).
title: Release 1.17.0
